name: Augmented GD
description: Turn every level into a roguelite run. Die, draft an augment, get stronger, and finally beat it.

min-charge.name: Minimum charge per death
min-charge.description: Each death charges the draft gauge by the percent you reached, but never less than this.

draft-threshold.name: Draft gauge threshold
draft-threshold.description: Gauge charge needed to earn one augment draft. Leftover charge carries over.

keybind-slowmo.name: Toggle Slow-Mo
keybind-slowmo.description: Toggles the Slow-Mo augment on/off during a run.

debug-augment-keys.name: Debug: number keys grant augments
debug-augment-keys.description: During a run, keys 1-6 add one level of the matching augment (table order: Shield, Slow-Mo, Checkpoint, Foresight, Unmirror, Blunt). Testing aid.

keybind-checkpoint.name: Place Checkpoint
keybind-checkpoint.description: Places a checkpoint (Checkpoint augment) during a run.
